customManagers.description: Images pinned as image:tag@sha256:digest in a Rust const, the value on the line after a renovate comment or the one after that, where rustfmt moves a long literal. The shared preset's manager captures a bare tag with no digest, so it cannot keep these current. DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE in src/deployment/registry.rs is the reason it exists: every generated Dockerfile builds FROM it. A tag with no image name before it does not match.

The two copies of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE that carry no renovate comment: the contract schema default and the runtime stage shown in docs/deployment/artefacts.md. A test compares the committed schema with the Rust types, so a pull request that moves registry.rs alone fails CI.

packageRules.description: The skeleton chart is a template the assembler rewrites per app, and its dependency points at oci://registry.example.com, which does not resolve. Looking it up fails DNS, which Renovate reports as 'Error obtaining docker token' on every run.
OpenTelemetry SDK + exporters + the tracing bridge + the metrics bridge move in lockstep -- held at 0.31 while metrics-exporter-opentelemetry requires it. Bumping one alone breaks the build.
The same ceilings Cargo.toml declares, so Renovate stops proposing a minor the lockstep cannot take until metrics-exporter-opentelemetry moves past opentelemetry 0.31.
tonic + prost are generated-and-linked together (build.rs codegen); never bump one without the other.
AWS SDK crates (aws-config, aws-sdk-*) share a release train and must move together.
metrics facade + exporters version together. The OpenTelemetry exporter follows the opentelemetry group instead.

testcontainers-modules 0.15.0 requires testcontainers ^0.27, so testcontainers 0.28 does not resolve. Lift this once a testcontainers-modules release requires testcontainers 0.28, and move both in one pull request.

Every debian pin moves in one pull request: the loadgen Dockerfiles, DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE and its two copies. The preset files regex-manager pins under annotated-pins, apart from the Dockerfiles, so #332 moved the Dockerfiles alone and #334 moved the rest by hand.
